a261030p1.summary: Chinese state-linked hackers targeted more than 200 organizations in just 11 days, using AI to attack governments and businesses worldwide, according to CrowdStrike.
a261030p1.title: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)

a261030p10.summary: Britain's competition regulator on Friday said it has opened an investigation into whether Meta (META.O) was imposing exploitative terms …
a261030p10.title: The UK CMA opens a probe into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers to use their content to develop its AI and other services (Reuters)

a261030p11.summary: Kioxia Holdings Corp. delivered a profit outlook that trailed estimates, warning that an AI-fueled surge in flash memory chip prices …
a261030p11.title: NAND maker Kioxia reports FY Q2 operating profit up 22x YoY to ~$12.7B, in line with est., but forecasts Q3 operating profit of ~$12.7B, below ~$14.9B est. (Takashi Mochizuki/Bloomberg)

a261030p12.summary: China's CXMT (688825.SS) said on Friday it swung to a net profit in the third quarter as surging AI-driven demand drove prices higher for its memory chips.
a261030p12.title: CXMT reports Q3 revenue of ~$16.7B, up 613.2% YoY, and a net profit of ~$8.17B, swinging to profitability on the back of rising AI-driven memory chip prices (Reuters)

a261030p2.summary: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, has pledged to cover all losses from a hack that it said drained around US$6.3 billion from its wallet.
a261030p2.title: Binance pledges to cover all losses from a ~$6.3B hack, potentially the largest crypto theft ever, surpassing the $1.5B Bybit hack in February 2025 (South China Morning Post)

a261030p3.summary: North Korean hackers were behind a $6.3 billion raid on cryptocurrency exchange Binance, according to US blockchain analysis firm TRM Labs.
a261030p3.title: TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)

a261030p4.summary: A new startup called &Truth is joining the race to automate formal verification, a painstaking process that uses math to prove software works as intended.
a261030p4.title: How a wave of startups are betting on AI to make formal software verification practical and essential, including &Truth, which launches with a $70M seed (Paresh Dave/Wired)

a261030p5.summary: Streaming service plans to charge users up to $5 a month to use the feature — Spotify is targeting an early 2027 launch …
a261030p5.title: Sources: Spotify aims to launch an AI product in Q1 2027 that lets subscribers create their own remixes and covers for ~$5 per month, pending licensing deals (Anna Nicolaou/Financial Times)

a261030p6.summary: Nvidia-backed neocloud bets on West Virginia data centre campus hit by construction issues, local opposition and financing risks — NEW
a261030p6.title: Inside Nscale's 2,250-acre, 8GW Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia, which has been hit by construction issues, local opposition, and financing risks (Financial Times)

a261030p7.summary: As AI transforms the accounting industry, Ravical aims to help firms turn individual expertise into shared knowledge …
a261030p7.title: Ravical, whose AI-powered platform helps accounting and tax firms manage their operations, raised a $17M seed led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25M (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)

a261030p8.summary: Andy Alder and Arjun Mather were Stanford roommates who both studied computer science before spending a decade at Palantir.
a261030p8.title: Dream, which is training AI world models on US building data to automate construction design and engineering, emerges from stealth with a $17M seed led by a16z (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)

a261030p9.summary: Investigation update: Our initial investigation suggested that the security incident may have involved a compromised laptop, however our subsequent investigation has uncovered additional points of breach. This was a complex attack, and we are doing all we can in coordination with law enforcement...
a261030p9.title: Binance reveals that a follow-up investigation has found "additional points of breach" beyond a possibly compromised laptop and says this was a "complex attack" (@binance)
